rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something plain and without any special qualities.

example.english: This snack shop is nondescript and nothing special.
example.traditional: 呢間小食店普普通通，冇乜特別。
example.jyutping: ne1 gaan1 siu2 sik6 dim3 pou2 pou2 tung1 tung1 mou5 mat1 dak6 bit6

rows.note: Use this when the thing is visually inconspicuous or does not attract attention, such as an unremarkable car.

example.english: That car is nondescript, so it is hard to recognize when parked on the street.
example.traditional: 嗰架車樣子唔起眼，泊喺街邊好難認。
example.jyutping: go2 gaa3 ce1 joeng6 zi2 m4 hei2 ngaan5 paak3 hai2 gaai1 bin1 hou2 naan4 jan6

rows.note: Use this for something that is notably ordinary or lacking anything distinctive, with a slightly more polished tone.

example.english: The cover of this report is nondescript and will not leave a deep impression.
example.traditional: 呢份報告嘅封面平平無奇，唔會令人留下深刻印象。
example.jyutping: ne1 fan6 bou3 gou3 ge3 fung1 min2 ping4 ping4 mou4 kei4 m4 wui5 ling6 jan4 lau4 haa6 sam1 hak1 jan3 zoeng6
